title: Lease Manager
description:
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s retail stores, workplaces, and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world.
The Global Real Estate Lease Administration team is responsible for managing and administering Apple’s real estate leased and owned properties, reporting of portfolio key data and critical dates, maintaining the system of record, and developing relationships with property managers and landlords. The team works with many internal cross-functional business partners including Real Estate, Facilities, Project Management, Legal, Tax, Risk Management, Corporate Accounting and Finance. In addition, the team works with many external business partners such as outside legal counsel, third-party consultants and landlords.
We are seeking an experienced, collaborative, and highly motivated professional to join our team as a Lease Manager to oversee a portion of Apple’s Global Real Estate portfolio.
The Lease Manager will be responsible for ensuring the financial and legal compliance of their assigned lease portfolio. This position is integral to the day-to-day operations of the Global Lease Administration team, contributing to accurate lease management and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years of experience in Lease Management with database/records management;
BA or BS in Business, Real Estate, Finance or equivalent;
Ability to review, interpret and abstract legal real estate documents;
Proven financial, analytical and creative problem solving skills.
Preferred qualifications: Unsurpassed customer focus, with a “Can-Do” attitude.
Experience working and communicating with all levels of an organization.
Demonstrated success in managing multiple projects, and priorities concurrently in a fast-paced, high growth, and results driven environment.

title: Senior iOS App Development Engineer - Services Special Project
description:
At Apple, we build products and services that enrich the everyday lives of millions of people around the world. Our Services team is at the forefront of delivering intelligent, delightful experiences powered by Generative AI. We are looking for a senior iOS frameworks engineer to design and build the foundational on-device systems that power features across Apple's services ecosystem — from daemons and frameworks to cloud synchronization and metrics infrastructure.
As a senior member of the Services engineering team, you will own critical on-device framework and daemon components that enable Generative AI experiences across Apple platforms. This role is focused on platform-level engineering ie: building the systems, services, and infrastructure that sit beneath the UI layer and power intelligent features at scale.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
6+ years of software engineering experience on client-side or platform-level iOS systems
Strong proficiency in Swift and Objective-C, with experience shipping production-quality frameworks, daemons, or system APIs
Strong systems programming expertise, including concurrency, multithreading, memory management, and performance tuning
Understanding of systems-level concepts such as inter-process communication (XPC), process lifecycle management, and resource constraints
Experience integrating client applications with RESTful APIs and cloud services
Proficiency with development tools such as Xcode, LLDB, Instruments, and Git
Strong communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across a diversity of backgrounds and experiences
Highly organized, maintaining patience and composure to effectively operate within ambiguity
Preferred qualifications: Experience with CloudKit or similar distributed data synchronization technologies
Experience designing and delivering libraries, frameworks, or public/internal APIs
Strong debugging skills across the OS stack — frameworks, daemons, and supporting services
Experience optimizing software for performance, energy efficiency, and resource constraints on mobile platforms
Familiarity with metrics and telemetry frameworks, including instrumentation, data collection pipelines, and analytics
Experience with AI/ML principles or developing software that interfaces with large language models
Experience with SQL and database technologies
Track record of mentoring engineers and driving technical direction within a team

title: Software Engineer: Security & Identity Intern Opportunities for University Students, Redmond
description:
Overview
Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential, and excitement for the journey ahead.
As a Software Engineering Intern – Security & Identity, you will help build secure systems and services that protect users, data, devices, and cloud infrastructure. You will work on technologies related to authentication, authorization, identity, governance, compliance, and secure software development. You will collaborate with engineers to identify risks, strengthen defenses, and build solutions that help customers operate securely in an increasingly connected world. This opportunity will enable you to develop expertise in security engineering while contributing to technologies that support trust, privacy, and resilience at scale.
At Microsoft, Interns work on real-world projects in collaboration with teams across the world, while having fun along the way. You'll be empowered to build community, explore your passions and achieve your goals. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Applies engineering principles to solve complex problems through sound and creative engineering.
Works with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a feature.
Quickly learns new engineering methods and incorporates them into work processes.
Seeks feedback and applies internal or industry best practices to improve technical solutions.
Demonstrates skill in time management and completing software projects in a cooperative team environment.
Reviews current developments and proactively seeks new knowledge that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Currently pursuing Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with at least one semester/term remaining following the completion of the internship, OR currently pursuing Master’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with at least one semester/term remaining following the completion of the internship.
Preferred Qualifications
1+ year(s) of programming experience.
6+ months of experience in delivering projects in teams.
1+ year(s) of experience in developing and applying data structures and algorithms.
Coursework or experience in cybersecurity, networking, operating systems, or secure software development.
Familiarity with identity and access management concepts, authentication, authorization, RBAC, or governance controls.
Experience building software using C#, Java, Go, Rust, Python, or similar languages.
Interest in threat modeling, secure coding practices, compliance, cloud security, and protecting large-scale services.
The base pay range for this internship is USD $5,690.00 - $11,210.00 per month. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $7,410.00 - $12,250.00 per month.
Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:
https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-intern-pay
Applications for this role will be accepted during the first week of each month from August through February, or until all positions are filled.
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.
